title: Visitor bicycle parking: 0.1 spaces per dwelling (Table 2.3a)
text: Bicycle parking is provided on site and in accordance with Table 2.3b and Figure 2.3a. Table 2.3a Bicycle parking¹, Visitor: 0.1 space per dwelling (Location A and Location B). ¹Calculations of parking ratios shall be rounded to the nearest whole number, with fractions of 0.5 or greater rounded up (for example, 1.4 bays is rounded to 1 bay and 1.5 bays is rounded to 2 bays).

evaluator.label: 0.1 visitor spaces per dwelling, rounded to the nearest whole number with 0.5 rounded up

replaces.note: visitor 0.1 per dwelling only where 10 or more dwellings -> no threshold

verified.note: Clause cites 'Table 2.3b', which does not exist; visitor bicycle rate read from Table 2.3a (p19-20).

notes: new: no Chapter 3 equivalent. Table 2.3a visitor bicycle row. The 10-dwelling threshold is gone, so a visitor space arises from 5 apartments (0.5 rounds up) instead of 10. Same broken 'Table 2.3b' reference as C2.3.7.
